title: Find K-th node from start of linked list
description:
[Source: GFG Classic]
Given a singly linked list with N nodes and a number k, the task is to find the kth node from the beginning of the linked list (1-based index). If k > N, return -1.

Input Format:
First line: n k
Second line: n space-separated node values

Output Format:
K-th node value or -1
